title: Puppet provisioning fails on vagrant 1.7.3+
body:

The actual error is mangled (Any idea why?) and makes/made the debugging harder.

However, the actual command to be executed, is the following:

```
`$env:FACTER_jenkinsmaster='jenkins.lan'; `$env:FACTER_nodename='host-vagrant'; `$env:FACTER_nodedescription='Jenkins slave for windows builds. Remote desktop port : 33891'; `$env:FACTER_additionallabels='';  puppet apply --modulepath '/tmp/vagrant-puppet/modules-690778006f7cb561e8d34ed85c0a2a69;/ProgramData/PuppetLabs/puppet/etc/modules' --color=false --detailed-exitcodes --manifestdir /tmp/vagrant-puppet/manifests-846018e2aa141a5eb79a64b4015fc5f3 /tmp/vagrant-puppet/manifests-846018e2aa141a5eb79a64b4015fc5f3/default.pp; exit $LASTEXITCODE
```

As it can be seen, we have the back tick which messes everything up.

Now, the back tick might have made sense up until we used commands embedded in the file, but that was rewritten exactly starting with 1.7.3  in commit https://github.com/mitchellh/vagrant/commit/1152b4e1df97fb5f468491954932d4f0c09875b1 (which was done in response to issue #5790). The original back tick was added in commit https://github.com/mitchellh/vagrant/commit/7d52f0e14d195841c72068ff9bcf1f4ad3ae7ce9 (for bug #3958).

As it can be seen from the first comment, removing the back tick renders everything working again.

I have prepared a PR for fixing this.

LE:
The relevant `Vagrantfile` section which sends the puppet facts:

``` ruby
vm.vm.provision "puppet" do |puppet|
        puppet.manifests_path = 'puppet/manifests'
        puppet.module_path    = 'puppet/modules'
        puppet.facter         = {
          "jenkinsmaster"    => "jenkins.lan",
          "nodename"         => "-vagrant".prepend("#{`hostname`}".chop),
          "nodedescription"  => "Jenkins slave for windows builds. Remote desktop port : " + (remote_desktop_port_start + i).to_s,
          "additionallabels" => "",
        }
      end
```
